$schemaNote: For the Celery worker service, add a second Railway service from the same repo, set root to ./backend, and override the start command to: celery -A app.services.celery_tasks.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2

celery-worker._comment: Add this as a separate Railway service. It shares the same Dockerfile as the API but overrides the start command to run the Celery worker instead of uvicorn. Ensure REDIS_URL, CELERY_BROKER_URL, and CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND env vars are set.
